/itineraryStops/6/whyOnRoute.source_en: **The seaside finale — and the closest stop to Jeju City.** After the UNESCO afternoon at Seongsan, the day winds down at ⟦G0⟧: emerald water, white sand, and a stretch of Olle Trail Course 19 in the softer late-afternoon light, when the day-trip crowds have thinned. Because Hamdeok sits on the coastal road back to Jeju City, ending here also makes the ride home the shortest of the day — an easy landing before drop-off.

/itineraryStops/6/convenience/restroom.source_en: Public restrooms and shower facilities at beach

/itineraryStops/6/description.source_en:
**⟦G0⟧ (함덕 서우봉 해변)** is one of Jeju's best-known east-coast beaches, loved for its bright sand, shallow emerald water, and the small volcanic cone of **Seoubong (서우봉)** rising at the eastern end. 

The main beach and connected coves give guests an easy, unhurried look at Jeju's coastal scenery without a long walk, and the seaside promenade is suitable for families and seniors. 

In spring, the slopes around Seoubong often turn yellow with canola flowers; in clear weather, the short upper path gives a broad view over the eastern coastline. 

The area also has a historical layer: coastal caves and wartime remains around Seoubong are connected with Japan's late-colonial military presence on Jeju, adding context beyond the beach view. Hamdeok is also part of **Jeju Olle Trail Course 19**, so guests can experience a small piece of Jeju's walking culture before moving inland. 

Admission is free, and the stop works well as a relaxed photo and wind-down point at the end of the eastern route.

/itineraryStops/6/visitBasics/hours.source_en: Open 24 hours (beach); managed swim season July–August with lifeguards

/itineraryStops/6/visitBasics/walking.source_en: Easy — beach is flat sand; Seoubong hike is moderate (steps)

/itineraryStops/7/description.source_en:
**Drop-off mirrors the morning pickup** with an optional Dongmun Market end-of-day stop: **Dongmun Traditional Market (동문시장)** is a ~25-min coach ride from Hamdeok Beach and offers Jeju's most popular evening market for **fresh seafood, Jeju tangerine products, and street-food dinner options** — guests can choose to drop here for independent dining + market shopping or continue to **Jeju City Hall** and **Jeju International Airport** drop-off points. 

Estimated arrival: **Dongmun Market ~18:00, City Hall ~18:15, Airport ~18:30**. Same-day evening flights from JIA (last departure ~21:30) are typically viable from this drop-off timing.
